plugins.name: security-scanner
plugins.description: Scan plugins and skills for security risks (multi-agent support)

plugins.name: extract-rules
plugins.description: Extract project-specific coding rules from codebase for AI agents

plugins.name: merge-rules
plugins.description: Merge portable coding rules from multiple projects into a unified rule set

plugins.name: caffeinate
plugins.description: Manage macOS caffeinate to prevent system sleep

plugins.name: peer
plugins.description: Peer engineer for code review, planning, and brainstorming

plugins.name: translate
plugins.description: AI-powered translation plugin with /tr command (--hq for high-quality)

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Guided development workflow: task decomposition, planning, peer plan review, browser plan approval, implementation, tidy, check/test, rules and code review, one commit per build step, rule updates, retrospectives; mob mode for a junior navigator

plugins.name: dev-workflow-bundle
plugins.description: Development workflow bundle (includes peer + extract-rules + dev-workflow + rules-review + tidy + prose-polish + mobpro + kabeuchi + artifactor)

plugins.name: mobpro
plugins.description: Learning-oriented (mob-programming) entry point that runs dev-workflow in mob mode: the AI drives and narrates, the junior reviews each diff

plugins.name: artifactor
plugins.description: A background drawing hand for a one-page, picture-first HTML artifact that grows over a session: one agent dispatched once and resumed with a message each turn, the page republished to the same URL whenever a section changes. Used on its own with /artifactor, or by a skill such as kabeuchi that supplies what the page holds

plugins.name: kabeuchi
plugins.description: A sounding-board session that grows a picture-first, one-page artifact with a reader who cannot yet picture the subject — a task, a question or a choice, in this codebase or outside it — until they say it has come together; then asks once whether to hand off to a /mobpro or /dev-workflow run, ending with the two --resume lines on yes or the page URL on no. Requires the artifactor plugin, which draws the page

plugins.name: apply-rules
plugins.description: Apply organization-wide rules to projects (filter by tech stack, merge with existing rules)

plugins.name: rules-review
plugins.description: Check code changes for .claude/rules/ compliance using parallel sub-agent review

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then apply cleanup edits.

plugins.name: prose-polish
plugins.description: Refactor verbose or unnatural prose into concise, native-sounding text in a configured target language using a sonnet subagent (file mode rewrites in place, text mode returns the result)
